title: STATIC's bumps
about: Short interstitials from STATIC's crew for Den TV's night block (bromigos-mascot-art)

bumps.caption: STILL LIT
bumps.about: RECON's OWL keeps watch on a cliff at night: the night block's ident

bumps.caption: BACK IN A MOMENT
bumps.about: RIG's LINEMAN hangs from a cable, fixing a junction box in a shower of sparks
RIG's LINEMAN rides a power cable down a ship's corridor

bumps.caption: STAY TUNED
bumps.about: NOIR hosts the late-night broadcast from his pod
STATIC's signal races down a cable into NOIR's console
The takeover: a dormant repair robot wakes up as STATIC's LINEMAN
The crew on the ship: OWL at the viewport, LINEMAN at a junction box, NOIR on the bridge

bumps.caption: SIGNING OFF
bumps.about: NOIR powers down for the night: the night block's sign-off
